message.reasoning_content:
We need to identify crimes based on facts: There was a fight, a worker (王1) used a crowbar and together with others beat victim 黎某某 on head, causing serious injury (second-degree serious injury). This is assault causing serious injury. In Chinese criminal law, that is "故意伤害罪" (intentional injury). Since injury is serious, it may be "故意伤害致重伤罪" (intentional injury causing serious injury). Also there is a dispute over labor contract, but the fact only mentions violent assault. Could also be "聚众斗殴罪"? The fact says "双方在工地上发生打斗，打斗过程中木工组工人被告人王1持撬棍伙同他人将125项目部工人被害人黎某某头部打伤". This is a group fight, but the main crime is intentional injury. Could also be "非法拘禁"? No. So likely "故意伤害罪". If the injury is serious, the charge is "故意伤害致重伤罪". In Chinese law, the crime is "故意伤害罪" with aggravating circumstance of causing serious injury. So we list "故意伤害罪". Also maybe "聚众斗殴罪" if the fight involved multiple people. The law: Article 293 of Criminal Law: "聚众斗殴，情节严重的，处三年以下有期徒刑、拘役或者管制". But the fact includes use of weapon (crowbar) and serious injury, which may be considered "聚众斗殴致人重伤" which could be charged as "聚众斗殴罪" or "故意伤害罪". Usually prosecutors choose the more serious: intentional injury causing serious injury. So we list that.

Thus answer: [罪名]故意伤害罪<eoa>
